;Disaster and accidents
*[[Vietjet Air]] flight VJ 356 crashed upon landing at Buon Ma Thuot International Airport while carrying 207 passenger and crew. Six people were injured but all survived. [https://vnexpress.net/tin-tuc/thoi-su/giao-thong/may-bay-vietjet-air-gap-su-co-khi-ha-canh-o-buon-ma-thuot-3846909.html (VnExpress)]

;Arts and culture
*[[Reggae]] music is added to the [[UNESCO]] [[UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage Lists#Representative list of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity|Representative list of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity]]. [https://www.npr.org/2018/11/29/671846799/reggae-a-voice-for-all-added-to-intangible-cultural-heritage-list-by-unesco (NPR)] [https://ich.unesco.org/en/RL/reggae-music-of-jamaica-01398 (UNESCO)]

;Business and economy
*The [[Germany|German]] chemical and pharmaceutical company [[Bayer]] is to cut 12,000 jobs by the end of 2021 as part of an overhaul following its acquisition of [[Monsanto]] earlier in 2018. [https://edition.cnn.com/2018/11/29/business/bayer-job-cuts-monsanto/index.html (CNN)]
*[[CNN]] announces it has severed ties with liberal commentator [[Marc Lamont Hill]] after he gives a U.N. speech advocating for [[Palestinians|Palestinian]] rights in which he used the phrase, "free Palestine [[Palestinian_nationalism#From_the_river_to_the_sea|from the river to the sea]]". [https://www.cnn.com/2018/11/29/media/marc-lamont-hill-cnn/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/2018/11/29/cnn-fires-marc-lamont-hill-wake-remarks-criticizing-israel-calling-free-palestine/ (''The Washington Post'')]

;International relations
*[[Russia–Ukraine relations]]
**[[Ukraine]]'s [[Ministry of Infrastructure (Ukraine)|Infrastructure Minister]] [[Volodymyr Omelyan]] says the ports of [[Berdiansk]] and [[Port of Mariupol|Mariupol]] are effectively under [[blockade]] as [[Russia]] refuses to let any Ukrainian vessels leave or enter the [[Sea of Azov]]. President [[Petro Poroshenko]] calls on [[NATO]] to send warships to patrol the Sea of Azov. [https://reuters.com/article/uk-ukraine-crisis-azov-blockade/russia-blocks-ukrainian-azov-sea-ports-minister-idUKKCN1NY0NQ (Reuters)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/nov/29/russia-blocked-ukrainian-azov-sea-ports-minister (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Russia–NATO relations]]
**The [[Belgian Air Component]] informs on Twitter that yesterday, Belgian [[General Dynamics F-16 Fighting Falcon|F-16]]s operating in the Baltic region for [[NATO]]'s [[Baltic Air Policing]] mission, "intercepted" [[Russian Air Force|Russian]] [[Sukhoi Su-27|Flanker]] jets, allegedly because they had no [[flight plan]]. [https://www.hln.be/nieuws/buitenland/belgische-f-16-s-onderscheppen-russische-straaljagers-in-baltische-regio~aa66376a/ (Belga via ''Het Laatste Nieuws'')]
*[[2018 G20 Buenos Aires summit]]
**An emergency landing delays [[Chancellor of Germany|German chancellor]] [[Angela Merkel]]'s arrival at the summit due to a complete shutdown of the onboard-ground communication system aboard the official [[Konrad Adenauer (aircraft)|Airbus A340-313 ''Konrad Adenauer'']]. [http://www.spiegel.de/politik/deutschland/angela-merkel-verpasst-g20-start-flugabbruch-wegen-komplett-ausfall-des-funksystems-a-1241166.html (''Der Spiegel'')] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-46394989 (BBC News)]
**[[Russia–United States relations]]
***After [[Government of Russia|Kremlin]] spokesman [[Dmitry Peskov]] said on Wednesday the meeting between U.S. President [[Donald Trump]] and Russian President [[Vladimir Putin]] during the summit is still on, while flying to [[Argentina]], President Trump tweets that, after conferring with his top National Security advisers, he decided to cancel the meeting, adding that it was not a good time [[Kerch Strait incident|since Russia has not returned the ships and sailors]] to [[Ukraine]]. Less than an hour earlier, Trump said that he would "probably" meet Putin and that he believed it was "a good time to have the meeting." [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/2018/11/29/trump-putin-meeting-g-20-argentina/2147198002/ (''USA Today'')] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-g20-summit-trump-cancellation/trump-decided-to-cancel-putin-meeting-while-on-flight-to-g20-spokeswoman-idUSKCN1NY2BR (Reuters)] [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/2018/11/29/donald-trump-cohen-plea-adds-scrutiny-putin-meeting-g-20-summit/2120967002/ (''USA Today''²)]

;Law and crime
*[[Mueller special counsel investigation]]
**[[Michael Cohen (lawyer)|Michael Cohen]], former personal lawyer for U.S. President [[Donald Trump]] and [[The Trump Organization]], pleads guilty to lying to Congress about [[Business projects of Donald Trump in Russia|Trump's Russian business]] [[Links between Trump associates and Russian officials|contacts]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/michael-cohen-expected-plead-guilty-lying-congress-collusion/story?id=59491450 (ABC News)] 
*German police raid [[Deutsche Bank]]'s offices in [[Frankfurt]] in connection with [[money laundering]] allegations that two staff members helped clients set up off-shore businesses as [[tax haven]]s. Police officers, prosecutors and tax inspectors search six of the bank's offices and seize numerous written and electronic business documents. Deutsche Bank says the investigation stems from the 2016 [[Panama Papers]] leak. [https://www.cnbc.com/2018/11/29/deutsche-bank-shares-sink-police-raid-offices-money-laundering-allegations.html (CNBC)]
*Convicted murderer [[Samuel Little]] confesses to murdering 90 women between 1970 and 2005, making him one of the most prolific [[serial killer]]s in [[United States|U.S.]] history. The [[Federal Bureau of Investigation]] has confirmed 34 of his confessions and are now working to confirm the others. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-46384197 (BBC)] [https://www.fbi.gov/news/stories/vicap-links-murders-to-prolific-serial-killer-112718#Map (FBI)]

;Politics and elections
*Former [[President of Taiwan|Taiwanese President]] [[Lee Teng-hui]] is rushed to [[Taipei Veterans General Hospital]] after falling and hitting his head. [https://www.taiwannews.com.tw/en/news/3585898 (''Taiwan News'')]
*[[2018 Georgian presidential election]]
**Voters in [[Georgia (country)|Georgia]] elect [[Salome Zurabishvili]] as [[President of Georgia|president]]. She will be the first woman elected to hold the position when she assumes office on 16 December 2018. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-46376344 (BBC)]
*[[2017–18 United States political sexual scandals]]
**[[Eric C. Bauman]] resigns as [[California Democratic Party]] chairman after accusations of sexual misconduct and inappropriate behavior toward party staff members and activists. [https://www.latimes.com/politics/la-pol-ca-california-democratic-party-chairman-eric-bauman-resignation-20181129-story.html (''Los Angeles Times'')]
